title: Sign encoding of the binary inner product
statement: For each natural number $n$, the real-valued function on binary vectors of length $2n$ is the real sign encoding of the inner product modulo two of the corresponding bit vector.
caveat: The definitions of the bit inner product and real sign encoding are not included, so their precise conventions cannot be stated.
